              LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty (outputs.Algorithms.DobocKTuning.sourceInput p.toPublic) f p.xstar ≤
            p.ε

                    LongTails.Setups.DobocK.StepSizeLemma5 p →
                      ∀ (xstar : OracleTemplate.DobocK.Stacked p.n p.dim),
                        IsMinOn (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f) Set.univ xstar →

                              (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
                                LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar) →

                                    LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f xstar) ∧

                                    (LongTails.Setups.DobocK.penalty p.toPublic f p.x0 -
